title: Geometric section coordinates for the affine diagonal
statement: For the ordered affine tower X over an arbitrary Y, define z0:X→A^d_X by the standard affine-space zero section and the fixed tower isomorphism. The section invariant of this standard pair is defined before integration. For any isomorphism of section pairs e:(U,f,s)→(A^d_B,p,z0), the geometric section comparison is the inverse of the canonical exceptional adjunction-mate base-change isomorphism, after the canonical identity pullback comparison. Specialize to the proved difference-coordinate isomorphism of the diagonal pair and to the homogeneous normal-coordinate isomorphism of its normal pair [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions, lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. The latter preserves zero because the conormal augmentation kills every degree-one generator and the normalized Rees comparison preserves augmentation. These comparisons use no integration orientation, annihilator exponent, or normalized DNC arrow.

def affineDiagonalSectionCoordinates (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {U B : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : U ⟶ B) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (s : B ⟶ U) (e : U ⟶ affineTraceTower B d) [IsIso e]
    (he : e ≫ affineTraceProjection B d = f)
    (hs : s ≫ e = affineDiagonalStandardZero B d) :
    Etale.sectionInvariant P.Coefficient f s ≅ P.affineDiagonalStandardSection B aB d
